# Resonance Creative Studio

> AI-powered creative studio that turns any URL, image, document, or prompt into posters, brochures, advertisements, social media posts, and cinematic videos.

Resonance Creative Studio generates two unique design variants per request, supports cross-posting to Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and includes AI-powered editing, object removal, and cinematic video rendering.
